faq.subtitle: Your question might already be answered below — it'll save you the wait.
faq.q1: How long will it take to get a response?
faq.a1: Within 24 business hours for requests sent through this form. For a faster reply, WhatsApp and WeChat are the most responsive channels during Chinese business hours (9am–6pm UTC+8).
faq.q2: I want to place an order, what should I prepare?
faq.a2: The product link or a clear photo, the desired quantity, and your delivery country and city. With these, we'll send you a full quote including the supplier price, shipping, and the total to pay.
faq.q3: Do you offer partnerships or B2B volume deals?
faq.a3: Yes. Select "Partnership" in the form and specify your estimated monthly volumes. Recurring orders benefit from negotiated terms with suppliers and grouped shipping rates.
faq.q4: I have an issue with an ongoing order, who do I contact?
faq.a4: Use the form with the subject "Technical support" and include your order number. Ongoing disputes are handled as a priority and you're kept informed at every step of the resolution with the supplier.
